reviewScope: Technical full decode plus sampled visual review. No human approval, star rating, creative acceptance or site publication claimed.

tool.versionLine: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

technical.durationMethod: 192 decoded frames with constant 512-tick spacing at timebase 1/12288; 24 fps; container header also reports 00:00:08.00.

audio.measurementMethod: ffmpeg volumedetect final block after complete AAC decode; 16-bit filter analysis. Initialization n_samples=0 excluded.
audio.interpretation: Near-silent signal, with a nonzero measured peak; audio track exists. This is not an audio-free file.

sourceComparison.metricMeaning: Decoded first frame versus original source pixels after RGB conversion. Compression/reconstruction difference, not a character-likeness grade or identity proof.
sourceComparison.qualitativeFinding: Source composition and character details are strongly retained in inspected first/last frames and sampled contact sheet.

sampledObservations.finding: AL, vertical G-A-I-B, paired segmented neck worms, central throat eye-disc, face geometry and dark curls remain recognizable and stable in sampled images.
sampledObservations.scope: Source and sampled frames; no new gold-standard or all-frame pass.

sampledObservations.finding: Iris color remains blue; the bright initial catchlight softens after one early eye-closure cycle. Both eyes appear fully closed around frames 18–26 (0.750–1.083s), reopening thereafter.
sampledObservations.scope: All first 48 eye crops examined; at-most-one-blink across the complete clip remains for full playback review.

sampledObservations.finding: Gaze remains source-like and slightly off-lens. Lips remain slightly parted as in the source, with no speech or singing evident in sampled frames.
sampledObservations.scope: A literal on-lens gaze and tightly sealed mouth are not established.

sampledObservations.finding: Single tube remains across character-right/viewer-left cheek. Existing brow ring and ear hoops remain on their source side; no new duplicated connector or jewelry is evident in inspected samples.
sampledObservations.scope: Source-specific preservation; inherited mirrored jewelry is not repaired or canon-approved.

sampledObservations.finding: Bronze armor, tan hood and raised gloved palm remain stable in sampled frames; no additional hand or new gesture is evident.
sampledObservations.scope: A definitive five-finger anatomy count is limited by overlap and frame-edge occlusion; not an anatomy pass.

sampledObservations.finding: The rig sinks beneath/behind the maw and dust, disappearing by later samples; existing fire flickers near it and is no longer visible after the rig vanishes.
sampledObservations.scope: Promising visible execution of the main rig-disappearance action; exact timing and interaction need playback review.

sampledObservations.finding: The worm head lowers as the rig disappears. The circular maw remains visibly open in the last frame rather than visibly sealed. Dust remains substantial at the end.
sampledObservations.scope: The intended closing/settling end state needs review; no pass or retry launched.

sampledObservations.finding: Character framing appears fixed through samples, warm haze remains consistent, and dust rolls toward the foreground. No new characters, cuts, text or watermark are evident in inspected samples.
sampledObservations.scope: No all-frame or normal-speed verification claimed.

experimentQualification: This is a distinct scene prototype with a new source, framing, outfit, breather, prop and action. It is an artistic progression from SW2, not a controlled A/B isolating the effect of fire.
nextReview: Root normal-speed playback: motion naturalness, blink count/duration, source gaze and mouth behavior.
Confirm whether the maw closure and dust end state meet the intended action, or retain the clip as a useful alternative.
Do not infer a production pass from clean decode or stable sampled appearance.
storage: Only new D: review derivatives and this append-only record were created. Source, downloaded original, author files, earlier receipts and site files remain unchanged.
